CC has profound impact on malnutrition. Fanzo and Downs (2021) have previously highlighted the relationship between CC
and nutrition-associated diseases (Fig. 3). Climate change augments malnutrition in four ways. Firstly, rising food prices will
impede the capacities of poor households in buying nutritious foods. This will have dire impacts on household food insecurity,
overall calorie consumption and intake of unhealthy foods. Secondly, women and young mothers perform manual labor in agri-
